title: api: add schema versioning + beta headers + backward-compat shims for streaming / function-calling
author: Evelyn Park
release_notes: Introduces API schema versioning tooling: opt-in beta header for schema_v2, server-side backward-compatibility shims for older clients, deprecation notices, and OpenAI-compat adapter updates. No immediate breaking changes; default behavior unchanged.
description: Context: As we iterate on streaming semantics, structured output and function/tool-calling surface, we need a safe way to evolve request/response schema without breaking existing customers. This PR introduces a lightweight schema versioning and beta opt-in header, server-side backward-compatibility shims, and updates to the OpenAI compatibility adapter to map new fields. Motivation: enable controlled rollout of schema_v2 (structured_output + normalized function_call semantics + streaming chunk metadata) while preserving existing behavior for clients on older SDKs/headers. Changes: - Add header parsing to accept opt-in preview header 'X-Redwood-API-Preview: schema_v2' and 'Accept-Beta: openai_streaming_schema_v2' for OpenAI-compatible requests. - Implement server-side shims (redwood.api.compat.shims) that transform incoming legacy requests to the new internal schema and transform responses back for older clients. Shims are feature-flagged and have telemetry to measure transformations. - Update OpenAI compatibility adapter to support: new structured_output key, normalized function_call object (name/arguments structured), and streaming metadata (chunk_type, part_index) in SSE events. Adapter will honor preview headers and remains backward compatible by default. - Add deprecation warnings: responses include 'X-Redwood-Deprecation-Warning' when clients use legacy fields; warnings include a migration doc link and a suggested timeline. - Tests: add unit + integration + compat-test matrix that exercises streaming SSE, function/tool calling, and structured output round-trips across header permutations. - Docs: add api-versioning.md with migration guide and timeline (60-day deprecation for legacy fields after notice). Rollout plan: canary on dedicated cluster for internal customers, monitor compat telemetry for 7 days, then progressive rollout to hosted API. If compatibility regressions detected, we will automatically roll back to previous adapter. Migration notes for customers: 1) To opt-in and test new schema, set header 'X-Redwood-API-Preview: schema_v2' on requests. 2) Update SDKs: python/ts SDKs will get helpers to opt-in with a single flag in next patch. 3) For streaming clients, expect additional SSE fields for structured_output chunks; if you parse generically you should continue to work. Testing and verification: unit/integration tests added; ran compat matrix against redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-typescript. Observability: telemetry events emitted for shim transformations and counts of deprecated-field usage. Related: ENG-5227 (schema v2 proposal), SUP-412 (customer-reported streaming mismatch).
